versions.changelog:
- Added comprehensive SKILL.md documentation covering all onboarding, lifecycle, and fleet management features for Huawei Cloud UCS clusters.
- Detailed prerequisites now include hcloud CLI setup, credential modes, security requirements, and IAM permissions.
- Kubernetes version compatibility and pre-registration checking now explained, including UCS maximum supported versions and command examples.
- Listed and described all primary capabilities, including cluster registration/deregistration, fleet group management, kubeconfig retrieval, and quota checks.
- Provided strong security best practices for credentials and IAM operations.
